insight.headline: VEL-11 breaks KEP's press at 82:47 with a 27.4 m line-breaking pass to VEL-09
insight.why_it_matters: With the score level at 2-2 in the 83rd minute, VEL-11 received at x=54.9 under pressure of 0.88 and still found VEL-09 at x=80.9, carrying the ball past the last line of KEP's block. Because the pass was completed rather than intercepted, KEP's mid-block was bypassed without a turnover, and the next action was a VEL-03 carry from x=80.9 to x=92.8 at pressure 0.25 — the sequence converted a contested regain into territory deep in the attacking third rather than a reset back into build-up.
insight.watch_next: Watch item, not a finding: KEP applied pressure through KEP-07 at 82:35 (pressure 0.62) before this break, and KEP-05 completed a 24.3 m pass at pressure 0.84 at 83:09; whether KEP sustain that level of counter-pressure on VEL's next progression attempt is worth monitoring.

fan_cards.headline: VEL-11 slips a 27-metre pass through KEP's wall
fan_cards.what_happened: Level at 2-2 in the 83rd minute, VEL-11 was under heavy pressure and still threaded a 27.4 m pass to VEL-09, skipping past KEP's block. VEL-03 then ran the ball deep.
fan_cards.why_it_matters: Like finding a gap in a locked door: instead of being forced backwards, VEL turned a scrappy regain into a dangerous attack, one pass turning defence into a threat.
fan_cards.watch_next: KEP pushed back hard right after — watch whether they keep that counter-pressure on VEL's next run forward.
fan_cards.how_we_know: The pass event at 82:47 (e-001092) records the 27.4 m completion under 0.88 pressure, with VEL-03's follow-up carry logged next (e-001093).

fan_cards.why_it_matters: Fue como abrir una puerta cerrada: en vez de devolver el balón, VEL convirtió un momento apretado en un ataque profundo.
fan_cards.watch_next: Ojo: si KEP vuelve a presionar igual en la próxima subida de VEL, ahí estará la clave.

fan_cards.headline: VEL-11 turns pressure into a line break at 82:47
fan_cards.what_happened: You pick it up at x=54.9 with pressure on you at 0.88 — no clean look. VEL-11 stays composed, rides it, and threads a 27.4 m pass to VEL-09 at x=80.9, right past KEP's last line. It comes straight off VEL-06's tackle won at 0.77, so it's a regain turned into a real attack, not a reset. VEL-03 keeps it rolling, carrying from x=80.9 to x=92.8 as the pressure drops to 0.25.
fan_cards.why_it_matters: That's the difference between surviving a press and beating it. Holding the ball at 0.88 pressure and still finding the forward pass takes nerve and clean body shape on the turn — and because it's completed, KEP's mid-block never gets to set. One pass turns a contested moment into territory deep in the attacking third.
fan_cards.watch_next: Watch whether KEP keep that counter-pressure — KEP-07 pressed at 82:35 and KEP-05 hit a 24.3 m pass at 0.84 pressure at 83:09.
fan_cards.how_we_know: The completed pass, its 0.88 pressure reading, and the following VEL-03 carry are logged as events e-001092 and e-001093.

fan_cards.headline: VEL-11 aguanta la presión y rompe el bloque de KEP con un pase de 27,4 m
fan_cards.what_happened: VEL-11 recibe en x=54,9 con presión de 0,88, se gira y filtra un pase de 27,4 m a VEL-09 en x=80,9, superando la última línea de KEP. La acción nace de un tackle ganado por VEL-06 y no de una posesión asentada. Después, VEL-03 conduce desde x=80,9 hasta x=92,8 con la presión cayendo a 0,25.
fan_cards.why_it_matters: Para ti, mediocentro: recibir de espaldas bajo presión alta no obliga a devolver el balón. Protege el cuerpo, gana medio metro y juega hacia adelante entre líneas; un solo pase completado convierte una recuperación disputada en campo rival en lugar de reiniciar la construcción.
fan_cards.watch_next: Ojo a la contra-presión de KEP: KEP-07 presionó a 0,62 en el 82:35 y KEP-05 completó un pase de 24,3 m a 0,84 en el 83:09; ver si mantienen ese ritmo en la siguiente progresión de VEL.
fan_cards.how_we_know: Se basa en el evento e-001092 (presión 0,88, pase de 27,4 m, x=54,9 a x=80,9) y en los eventos vinculados e-001091 y e-001093.

fan_cards.headline: VEL-11 在 82:47 顶着 0.88 压迫，用 27.4 米直塞撕开 KEP 防线
fan_cards.what_happened: 82:47、比分 2-2 时，VEL-11 在 x=54.9 处背身接球，身上压着 0.88 的逼抢强度。他没有回传，而是向前推进并把球送到 x=80.9 的 VEL-09 脚下——这一脚横跨 27.4 米，直接越过 KEP 最后一道防线，难度评分 7.2。做完这个动作后他没有停，球权随即交给 VEL-03，从 x=80.9 一路带到 x=92.8，此时压迫已降到 0.25。
fan_cards.why_it_matters: 对 VEL-11 来说，关键不在于传得多远，而在于他在最高压的那一刻没有把球丢掉：这次传球是完成而不是被断，KEP 的中场block被整段绕过，一次刚抢回来的球权直接变成了进攻三区深处的球权，而不是被迫退回后场重新组织。
fan_cards.watch_next: 继续留意 VEL-11 下一次向前推进时 KEP 的反应：KEP-07 在 82:35 曾以 0.62 的压迫上前，KEP-05 在 83:09 也顶着 0.84 的压迫完成过 24.3 米传球，看 KEP 能不能把这种反压维持住。
fan_cards.how_we_know: 这些数据来自 82:47 那次传球事件（e-001092）以及与之相连的 VEL-06 抢断（e-001091）和 VEL-03 带球（e-001093）的事件记录。
